coverage.split_rule: assigned by family index before any rendering is built, so no derived item of a family crosses the split
coverage.structure_overlap_statement: 96 families share 6 topologies: structure repeats while labels, domains and renderings do not. Familiar-structure/new-instance items are therefore a separate class from unseen arrangements and are counted separately, never merged.
